panorama.title: 360° Virtual Tour
panorama.subtitle: Explore the Tashkent City panorama interactively.
panorama.aboutText: Tashkent City is a modern business and entertainment complex in the heart of Uzbekistan's capital. The complex features impressive skyscrapers, luxury hotels, shopping malls, and beautifully landscaped parks. Its gleaming towers and wide boulevards offer stunning panoramic views of the entire city.
